description:
Goal: make a definition carry the lexical env it was created in. Add env to FunctionSource. The constructor supplies it: the canonical path projects env from the scope position (project_env_value Definition) and attaches it; the macro path carries the Fz.Compiler.define(source, __CALLER__) env. Delete FunctionEnvSource and the function_env field on FragmentPublicationContext; the publish path reads definition.env with no branch. Exclude env from source_same: it is a pure projection of {module, function, namespace} already compared there, a derived cache. Telemetry env_root_ref reads the stored env.

Grounding: FunctionSource has no env field today; the projected env flows only to emit_compiler_service_define (env_root_ref, source_publish.rs:1459) and is then discarded. FunctionEnvSource::ProjectDefinition vs Fixed is the publication-mode branch (source_publish.rs:65-110, 705); its two arms are exactly canonical-projection vs macro-carry.

Signal: FunctionEnvSource and the context mode field deleted; env stored on every FunctionSource; source_same surface unchanged (env excluded); env_root_ref telemetry still asserted (source_publish_test.rs:132); full lib green with zero warnings.

Strategy: data-model up. Depends on fz-rh2.28.2 (canonical vs user origin is explicit). Blocks fz-rh2.28.4.

comments.text: Dependency note: blocked by fz-s00 (the phase-vs-origin / read-source-once step), which replaced the deleted fz-rh2.28.2. Where the description says "Depends on fz-rh2.28.2," read fz-s00.

title: Compiler2 definition env: carry it on the definition
